title: Paul McCartney live: Santa Barbara Bowl, Santa Barbara | 2025
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Santa Barbara Bowl in Santa Barbara, California, USA, on 26 September 2025.

It was the first show of the Got Back North American Tour 2025. McCartney performed The Beatles’ ‘Help!’ for the first time since 29 July 1990, when it was part of a John Lennon medley, and the first time in its entirety since 12 December 1965.

The Santa Barbara show was a warm-up for the North American leg of the tour, and was announced just two weeks previously. The venue seats just 4,562 people, making it a relatively intimate McCartney show.

Tickets sold out in minutes, and fans were made to secure their phones in Yondr pouches during the show. The setlist was slightly truncated.

The Got Back Tour lasted for 80 dates between April 2022 and November 2025. Ringo Starr performed at the Santa Barbara Bowl on 12 July 2014.

McCartney’s band was Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens (vocals, keyboards, guitar, percussion, harmonica), Brian Ray (vocals, guitar, bass), Rusty Anderson (vocals, guitar), Abe Laboriel Jr (vocals, drums), Kenji Fenton (saxophone), Mike Davis (trumpet), and Paul Burton (trombone).
